summary: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames.
takeaways: To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models.
However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs.
Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames.
